```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
# Load the package from the checkout with pkgload; no package install is
# required. Under altdoc the render runs in a temp dir, so resolve the root
# first (CFB2NFL_ROOT in the site build, else walk up to the _targets store).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT", "")
if (!nzchar(root)) {
  dir <- getwd()
  while (!file.exists(file.path(dir, "_targets")) && dirname(dir) != dir) {
    dir <- dirname(dir)
  }
  root <- if (file.exists(file.path(dir, "_targets"))) dir else getwd()
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(ggiraph)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r}
#| label: data
#| include: false
picks <- dbReadTable(con, "picks")
roster <- dbReadTable(con, "roster")
coaches <- dbReadTable(con, "coaches")
nfl_rosters <- dbReadTable(con, "nfl_rosters")
nfl_draft_picks <- dbReadTable(con, "nfl_draft_picks")
# thousands-separated formatter for inline numbers in the narrative
fmt <- function(x, digits = 0) {
  formatC(as.numeric(x), big.mark = ",", format = "f", digits = digits)
}
```

## 1. Introduction

- A head coach is one voice on a staff, so what the data can support is a
  statement about association: the head coaches under whom a future draftee
  played.
- This post maps that landscape: how many head coaches the data holds, how
  many draftees they produced and at which positions, how many ran more
  than one program, and how the position picture changes for undrafted
  entrants, with one caveat up front about how the counting is done.

## 2. Data

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
*Data as of the `data-latest` release, retrieved 2026-10-30. The roster
records start in 2010, so this post covers draft classes from 2011 on, and
the coach landscape uses classes from 2014 on, where every draftee's
observable career is plausibly complete.*
:::

### The two counting rules differ only in how much of the pre-draft career each one covers

```{r}
#| label: rules-table
tibble::tribble(
  ~rule                                          , ~what_it_counts                              , ~names ,
  "Last school"                                  , "The player's final season before the draft" ,
  "Whoever finished the product"                 ,
  "Every season"                                 , "Every season the player played, once each"  ,
  "Everyone who oversaw part of the development"
) |>
  kable(
    caption = "The two counting rules. One roster season is enough under either rule."
  )
```

All head coaches recorded for a season count, midseason changes and
interim promotions included, because the claim is association rather than
sole responsibility; players with a known recycled athlete id, the same id
attached to two different careers, are excluded.

### The two rules name the same coach set for barely half of recent picks

Before the coach landscape, one caveat about the counting: because
transfers move draftees between programs, the two rules above disagree for
about half of the recent classes, and every coach-level count in this post
is reported under the last-school rule.

```{r}
#| label: rules-compute
reused <- reused_ids(roster)
# pool of pre-draft roster seasons for every eligible pick: reused below
pool <- picks |>
  filter(!is.na(playerId), year >= 2011, !playerId %in% reused) |>
  distinct(playerId, year, overall) |>
  inner_join(
    distinct(roster, playerId, season, team),
    by = "playerId",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) |>
  filter(season < year)
last_school <- link_coaches_picks(
  picks,
  roster,
  coaches,
  rule = "last",
  reused = reused
)
every_season <- link_coaches_picks(
  picks,
  roster,
  coaches,
  rule = "any",
  reused = reused
)
set_overlap <- function(y, o) {
  a <- last_school$coach_id[last_school$year == y & last_school$overall == o]
  b <- every_season$coach_id[every_season$year == y & every_season$overall == o]
  length(intersect(a, b)) / length(union(a, b))
}
keys <- distinct(last_school, year, overall)
ovl <- keys |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(ovl = set_overlap(year, overall)) |>
  ungroup()
by_class <- ovl |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    identical_share = mean(ovl == 1),
    n_picks = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
# transfer flag: a draftee whose pre-draft seasons span more than one team
pool_teams <- pool |>
  group_by(year, overall) |>
  summarise(n_teams = n_distinct(team), .groups = "drop")
xfer_share <- ovl |>
  left_join(pool_teams, by = c("year", "overall")) |>
  mutate(transferred = n_teams > 1) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(share = mean(transferred), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
#| label: rules-fig
#| fig-height: 6
window_mean <- mean(by_class$identical_share[by_class$year >= 2014])
p <- ggplot(by_class, aes(year, identical_share)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = window_mean, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%d: %.0f%% of %d picks",
        year,
        100 * identical_share,
        n_picks
      ),
      group = 1
    ),
    linewidth = 1.2,
    color = "#1b4f8a"
  ) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%d: %.0f%% of %d picks",
        year,
        100 * identical_share,
        n_picks
      )
    ),
    size = 2.4
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 2019.8,
    y = 0.88,
    label = "Above the line:\nmost picks name the\nsame coaches either way",
    size = 4.4,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  annotate(
    "curve",
    x = 2020.4,
    y = 0.82,
    xend = 2018.6,
    yend = 0.58,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 2011.8,
    y = 0.06,
    label = "Below the line: more picks than not\nname a different coach set\nwhen every season counts",
    size = 4.4,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  annotate(
    "curve",
    x = 2014.2,
    y = 0.15,
    xend = 2025.2,
    yend = 0.36,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * x),
    limits = c(0, 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "The two rules disagree on half of recent picks",
    subtitle = "Picks whose two coach sets are exactly identical, by draft class",
    x = "Draft class",
    y = "Picks naming the same coach set\nunder both rules",
    caption = "Dashed line: mean over classes 2014 and later. Overlap is an exact set match on coach ids."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6)
```

The slide tracks the transfer boom: draftees whose pre-draft seasons span
more than one team were under
`r sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * max(xfer_share$share[xfer_share$year <= 2013]))`
of early classes and above
`r sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * xfer_share$share[xfer_share$year == 2026])` of
the class of 2026, and holding the transfer share at its 2014 through 2023
level would erase the slide.

```{r}
#| label: rules-pin
stopifnot(
  by_class$identical_share[by_class$year == 2011] == 1,
  window_mean > 0.5,
  window_mean < 0.65,
  all(by_class$identical_share[by_class$year >= 2024] < 0.55),
  max(xfer_share$share[xfer_share$year <= 2013]) < 0.02,
  max(xfer_share$share[xfer_share$year == 2026]) > 0.45
)
```

## 3. Results

### Fewer than one in five head coaches has produced a draftee since 2014

```{r}
#| label: universe-nums
#| include: false
n_coaches_all <- n_distinct(coaches$coach_name)
n_coach_seasons <- nrow(coaches)
active <- coaches |>
  filter(season >= 2013) |>
  distinct(coach_id, coach_name)
producers <- last_school |>
  filter(year >= 2014) |>
  distinct(coach_id, coach_name)
```

The coaches table holds `r fmt(n_coach_seasons)` head-coach seasons
covering `r fmt(n_coaches_all)` distinct coaches back to
`r min(coaches$season)`; narrowing to the coaches active in the 2014 and
later draft classes shows how few of them ever produced a draftee.

```{r}
#| label: universe
universe <- tibble::tribble(
  ~group                                        , ~coaches        ,
  "Head coaches in the data, 1886 to 2026"      , n_coaches_all   ,
  "Head coaches active in the 2014 classes on"  , nrow(active)    ,
  "Of those, coaches with at least one draftee" , nrow(producers)
)
universe |>
  kable(
    col.names = c("Group", "Coaches"),
    caption = "The head-coach universe and the draftee-producing subset."
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: universe-pin
stopifnot(
  n_coaches_all == 1814,
  nrow(producers) == 305,
  nrow(producers) / nrow(active) < 0.75
)
```

### Quarterback draftees are the smallest share of the draft among field positions

```{r}
#| label: position-groups
pos_groups <- c(
  "Quarterback" = "QB",
  "Running Back" = "RB",
  "Fullback" = "RB",
  "Wide Receiver" = "WR/TE",
  "Tight End" = "WR/TE",
  "Offensive Tackle" = "OL",
  "Offensive Guard" = "OL",
  "Center" = "OL",
  "Defensive End" = "DL",
  "Defensive Edge" = "DL",
  "Defensive Tackle" = "DL",
  "Outside Linebacker" = "LB",
  "Inside Linebacker" = "LB",
  "Linebacker" = "LB",
  "Cornerback" = "DB",
  "Safety" = "DB",
  "Place Kicker" = "ST",
  "Punter" = "ST",
  "Long Snapper" = "ST"
)
pos_links <- last_school |>
  filter(year >= 2014) |>
  mutate(pos_grp = unname(pos_groups[position]))
stopifnot(!any(is.na(pos_links$pos_grp)))
pos_grp_summary <- pos_links |>
  distinct(year, overall, coach_id, coach_name, pos_grp) |>
  summarise(
    draftees = n(),
    coaches = n_distinct(coach_id),
    .by = pos_grp
  ) |>
  mutate(
    per_coach = draftees / coaches,
    share = draftees / sum(draftees),
    pos_grp = reorder(pos_grp, share)
  )
qb_row <- pos_grp_summary[pos_grp_summary$pos_grp == "QB", ]
qb_draftees <- qb_row$draftees
qb_coaches <- qb_row$coaches
qb_share <- qb_row$share
qb_per_coach <- qb_row$per_coach
```

Each draftee position group has its own supply of coaches, and raw counts
mostly track how many college players the position fields, so the groups
are compared as shares of all draftees: the quarterback group is the
smallest among field positions, `r fmt(qb_draftees)` draftees,
`r sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * qb_share)` of the total, from only
`r fmt(qb_coaches)` coaches, about `r sprintf("%.1f", qb_per_coach)` per
coach, against roughly 3 per coach for the defensive back and receiver
groups.

```{r}
#| label: position-fig
#| fig-height: 6
p_grp <- ggplot(pos_grp_summary, aes(y = pos_grp, x = 100 * share)) +
  geom_col_interactive(aes(
    tooltip = sprintf(
      "%s: %d draftees from %d coaches (%.1f per coach)",
      pos_grp,
      draftees,
      coaches,
      per_coach
    ),
    data_id = pos_grp
  )) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = sprintf(
        "%.1f%% (%d draftees, %d coaches)",
        100 * share,
        draftees,
        coaches
      ),
      hjust = -0.05
    ),
    size = 4.2
  ) +
  annotate(
    "curve",
    x = 24.4,
    y = 1.6,
    xend = 23.7,
    yend = 2,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 24.8,
    y = 1.25,
    label = sprintf(
      "The smallest field-position share:\n%d QB draftees, %.1f%% of all draftees,\nfrom only %d coaches",
      qb_draftees,
      100 * qb_share,
      qb_coaches
    ),
    size = 4.2,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  expand_limits(x = 44) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x)) +
  labs(
    title = "Receivers and defensive backs give the draft its volume",
    subtitle = "Share of all draftees by position group, 2014 classes on",
    x = "Share of all draftees",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Last-school rule. Each bar is the group's percent of all draftee-coach pairs; the label lists the counts behind it."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p_grp, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6)
```

```{r}
#| label: position-pin
stopifnot(
  pos_grp_summary$draftees[pos_grp_summary$pos_grp == "DB"] == 665,
  pos_grp_summary$coaches[pos_grp_summary$pos_grp == "DB"] == 200,
  pos_grp_summary$draftees[pos_grp_summary$pos_grp == "QB"] == 146,
  pos_grp_summary$coaches[pos_grp_summary$pos_grp == "QB"] == 91,
  pos_grp_summary$per_coach[pos_grp_summary$pos_grp == "QB"] <
    min(pos_grp_summary$per_coach[
      pos_grp_summary$pos_grp %in% c("DB", "WR/TE", "DL", "OL", "LB", "RB")
    ]),
  100 * pos_grp_summary$share[pos_grp_summary$pos_grp == "QB"] > 4,
  100 * pos_grp_summary$share[pos_grp_summary$pos_grp == "QB"] < 5
)
```

### Undrafted entry shrinks the quarterback share, it does not grow it

```{r}
#| label: udfa
nfl_groups <- c(
  QB = "QB",
  RB = "RB",
  FB = "RB",
  WR = "WR/TE",
  TE = "WR/TE",
  T = "OL",
  G = "OL",
  C = "OL",
  DE = "DL",
  DT = "DL",
  NT = "DL",
  DL = "DL",
  OLB = "LB",
  ILB = "LB",
  MLB = "LB",
  LB = "LB",
  CB = "DB",
  S = "DB",
  FS = "DB",
  SS = "DB",
  DB = "DB",
  K = "ST",
  P = "ST",
  LS = "ST",
  KR = "ST",
  PR = "ST"
)
# rookie-roster entries, split by whether the id ever appears in the draft
rookie_entries <- nfl_rosters |>
  filter(season == rookie_year, rookie_year >= 2014) |>
  distinct(gsis_id, position, rookie_year) |>
  filter(!is.na(gsis_id), !is.na(position)) |>
  as.data.frame()
drafted_ids <- nfl_draft_picks |>
  distinct(gsis_id) |>
  filter(!is.na(gsis_id)) |>
  pull(gsis_id)
entry_split <- rookie_entries |>
  mutate(g = unname(nfl_groups[position])) |>
  filter(!is.na(g)) |>
  mutate(route = if_else(gsis_id %in% drafted_ids, "Drafted", "Undrafted"))
entry_shares <- entry_split |>
  count(g, route, name = "n") |>
  group_by(route) |>
  mutate(share = 100 * n / sum(n)) |>
  ungroup()
n_undrafted <- sum(entry_shares$n[entry_shares$route == "Undrafted"])
n_drafted <- sum(entry_shares$n[entry_shares$route == "Drafted"])
pick_order <- entry_shares |>
  filter(route == "Drafted") |>
  arrange(desc(share)) |>
  pull(g)
qb_share_dr <- entry_shares$share[
  entry_shares$g == "QB" & entry_shares$route == "Drafted"
]
qb_share_ud <- entry_shares$share[
  entry_shares$g == "QB" & entry_shares$route == "Undrafted"
]
entry_shares <- entry_shares |>
  mutate(g = factor(g, levels = rev(pick_order)))
```

The same position comparison among undrafted entrants, players on an NFL
roster in their rookie season whose id never appears in the draft record,
shows the drafted quarterback share is not an artifact of who gets
drafted: the quarterback share falls by half, from
`r sprintf("%.1f%%", qb_share_dr)` of drafted rookies to
`r sprintf("%.1f%%", qb_share_ud)` of undrafted entrants, while receivers
and special teams take larger undrafted shares.

```{r}
#| label: udfa-fig
#| fig-height: 6
p_udfa <- ggplot(entry_shares, aes(y = g, x = share, fill = route)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = sprintf("%s, %s: %d (%.1f%%)", g, route, n, share),
      data_id = route
    ),
    position = "dodge"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%% (%s)", share, fmt(n))),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    hjust = -0.05,
    size = 3.6
  ) +
  annotate(
    "curve",
    x = 16.5,
    y = 2.9,
    xend = 7,
    yend = 3.15,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 17,
    y = 2.55,
    label = sprintf(
      "The quarterback share falls by half:\n%.1f%% drafted against %.1f%% undrafted",
      qb_share_dr,
      qb_share_ud
    ),
    size = 4.2,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  expand_limits(x = max(entry_shares$share) * 1.75) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x)) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(
    title = "Undrafted entry leans to receivers and away from quarterbacks",
    subtitle = "Share of each entry route's rookies by position group, 2014 rookie classes on",
    x = "Share of that entry route's rookies",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Entry route",
    caption = "Undrafted: an NFL rookie-roster season whose id never appears in the draft record. Read each group's pair of bars: lower drafted, upper undrafted."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p_udfa, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6)
```

```{r}
#| label: udfa-pin
stopifnot(
  n_undrafted == 4188,
  n_drafted == 2756,
  qb_share_ud < qb_share_dr / 1.8,
  entry_shares$share[
    entry_shares$g == "WR/TE" & entry_shares$route == "Undrafted"
  ] >
    entry_shares$share[
      entry_shares$g == "WR/TE" & entry_shares$route == "Drafted"
    ],
  entry_shares$share[
    entry_shares$g == "ST" & entry_shares$route == "Undrafted"
  ] >
    entry_shares$share[entry_shares$g == "ST" & entry_shares$route == "Drafted"]
)
```

### A fifth of recent draftees belong to ten coaches

```{r}
#| label: top-coaches
coach_totals <- pos_links |>
  distinct(year, overall, coach_id, coach_name) |>
  count(coach_id, coach_name, name = "draftees", sort = TRUE)
top_coach <- coach_totals |> slice_head(n = 12)
top10_n <- sum(coach_totals$draftees[1:10])
total_pairs <- sum(coach_totals$draftees)
top10_share <- top10_n / total_pairs
saban_total <- coach_totals$draftees[coach_totals$coach_name == "Nick Saban"]
```

Draftee production is top-heavy: the ten coaches with the most draftees
account for `r fmt(top10_n)` of `r fmt(total_pairs)` draftee-coach pairs,
about `r sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * top10_share)`, while half of the
`r fmt(nrow(coach_totals))` producing coaches account for five or fewer
each.

```{r}
#| label: top-coaches-fig
#| fig-height: 6
p_top <- ggplot(top_coach, aes(draftees, reorder(coach_name, draftees))) +
  geom_col_interactive(aes(
    tooltip = sprintf("%s: %d draftees", coach_name, draftees),
    data_id = coach_name
  )) +
  geom_text(aes(label = draftees, hjust = -0.15), size = 4.2) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 53,
    y = 2,
    label = sprintf(
      "The top ten names alone hold\n%.0f%% of all draftee-coach pairs",
      100 * top10_share
    ),
    size = 4.2,
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  expand_limits(x = max(top_coach$draftees) * 1.15) +
  labs(
    title = sprintf(
      "Saban's %d draftees lead a steep drop to the field",
      saban_total
    ),
    subtitle = "The twelve coaches with the most draftees, 2014 classes on",
    x = "Draftees",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Last-school rule. A coach's total spans schools, so these counts describe the coach, not the school-stint."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p_top, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 6)
```

```{r}
#| label: top-coaches-pin
stopifnot(
  coach_totals$draftees[coach_totals$coach_name == "Nick Saban"] == 99,
  coach_totals$draftees[coach_totals$coach_name == "Kirby Smart"] == 84,
  sum(coach_totals$draftees[1:10]) == 681,
  nrow(coach_totals) == 305,
  median(coach_totals$draftees) <= 5
)
```

### Each top coach's draftee mix leans a different direction

The totals hide what kind of players leave each program, so the nineteen
recorded positions are grouped into eight and stacked for the twelve
coaches with the most draftees.

```{r}
#| label: positions-fig
#| fig-height: 7
pos_totals <- pos_links |>
  count(coach_id, coach_name, name = "n_total")
top12 <- pos_totals |>
  arrange(desc(n_total), coach_name) |>
  slice_head(n = 12) |>
  pull(coach_name)
pos_mix <- pos_links |>
  filter(coach_name %in% top12) |>
  count(coach_name, pos_grp, name = "n") |>
  left_join(pos_totals, by = "coach_name") |>
  mutate(coach_name = reorder(coach_name, n_total))
mix_get <- function(coach, grp) {
  pos_mix$n[pos_mix$coach_name == coach & pos_mix$pos_grp == grp]
}
saban_db <- mix_get("Nick Saban", "DB")
saban_dl <- mix_get("Nick Saban", "DL")
saban_qb <- mix_get("Nick Saban", "QB")
ferentz_total <- pos_totals$n_total[pos_totals$coach_name == "Kirk Ferentz"]
ferentz_ol <- mix_get("Kirk Ferentz", "OL")
kelly_wrte <- mix_get("Brian Kelly", "WR/TE")
p_pos <- ggplot(pos_mix, aes(y = coach_name, x = n, fill = pos_grp)) +
  geom_col_interactive(aes(
    tooltip = sprintf("%s: %d %s draftees", coach_name, n, pos_grp),
    data_id = pos_grp
  )) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(
    title = "Saban's draftees skew defensive, Ferentz's to the line",
    subtitle = "Position mix of the twelve coaches with the most draftees",
    x = "Draftees",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Position group",
    caption = "Last-school rule. Read each bar left to right: the segments are the position groups behind the coach's total."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
girafe(ggobj = p_pos, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 7)
```

Nick Saban's `r fmt(saban_total)` draftees include `r fmt(saban_db)`
defensive backs and `r fmt(saban_dl)` defensive linemen but only
`r fmt(saban_qb)` quarterbacks, while Kirk Ferentz's
`r fmt(ferentz_total)` lean offensive line, `r fmt(ferentz_ol)` of
`r fmt(ferentz_total)`, and Brian Kelly's `r fmt(kelly_wrte)` receivers
and tight ends are the largest offensive group count among the top twelve.

```{r}
#| label: positions-pin
stopifnot(
  pos_totals$n_total[pos_totals$coach_name == "Nick Saban"] == 99,
  pos_mix$n[pos_mix$coach_name == "Nick Saban" & pos_mix$pos_grp == "DB"] == 20,
  pos_mix$n[pos_mix$coach_name == "Kirk Ferentz" & pos_mix$pos_grp == "OL"] ==
    11,
  pos_mix$n[pos_mix$coach_name == "Brian Kelly" & pos_mix$pos_grp == "WR/TE"] ==
    19
)
```

### Most draftee-producing coaches ran a single program

A coach's total spans schools, so whether the draftees followed the coach
or the program depends on how many programs he ran, and for most producing
coaches the answer is one.

```{r}
#| label: teams-coached
teams_per_coach <- coaches |>
  distinct(coach_id, school) |>
  count(coach_id, name = "n_teams") |>
  left_join(producers, by = "coach_id") |>
  filter(coach_name %in% coach_totals$coach_name) |>
  count(n_teams, name = "coaches")
teams_per_coach |>
  kable(
    col.names = c("Programs coached", "Draftee-producing coaches"),
    caption = "Programs coached per draftee-producing coach, 2014 classes on."
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: movers
movers <- c(
  "Lincoln Riley",
  "Brian Kelly",
  "Kalen DeBoer",
  "Lane Kiffin",
  "Steve Sarkisian",
  "Mario Cristobal",
  "Josh Heupel",
  "Jimbo Fisher"
)
mover_detail <- pos_links |>
  filter(coach_name %in% movers) |>
  group_by(coach_name, team) |>
  summarise(
    draftees = n(),
    first_class = min(year),
    last_class = max(year),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(draftees))
mover_get <- function(coach, team) {
  mover_detail$draftees[
    mover_detail$coach_name == coach & mover_detail$team == team
  ]
}
kelly_total <- sum(mover_detail$draftees[
  mover_detail$coach_name == "Brian Kelly"
])
kelly_nd <- mover_get("Brian Kelly", "Notre Dame")
kelly_lsu <- mover_get("Brian Kelly", "LSU")
kiffin_om <- mover_get("Lane Kiffin", "Ole Miss")
kiffin_fa <- mover_get("Lane Kiffin", "Florida Atlantic")
kiffin_usc <- mover_get("Lane Kiffin", "USC")
mover_detail |>
  kable(
    caption = "Draftees by school for selected multi-program coaches, 2014 classes on. First and last draft class with a draftee under that coach at that school."
  )
```

The splits differ sharply: Kelly's `r fmt(kelly_total)` draftees divide
`r fmt(kelly_nd)`/`r fmt(kelly_lsu)` between Notre Dame and LSU while
Kiffin's Ole Miss total of `r fmt(kiffin_om)` dwarfs his
`r fmt(kiffin_fa)` each at Florida Atlantic and USC, the pattern that
motivates the coach-versus-program followup.

```{r}
#| label: movers-pin
stopifnot(
  teams_per_coach$coaches[teams_per_coach$n_teams == 1] == 162,
  mover_detail$draftees[
    mover_detail$coach_name == "Brian Kelly" &
      mover_detail$team == "Notre Dame"
  ] ==
    44,
  mover_detail$draftees[
    mover_detail$coach_name == "Lane Kiffin" &
      mover_detail$team == "Ole Miss"
  ] ==
    25
)
```

## 4. Summary

The head-coach landscape behind recent draft picks is narrow at the top.
Of `r fmt(n_coaches_all)` head coaches in the data, `r fmt(nrow(producers))`
produced a draftee in the 2014 and later classes, and ten of those
`r fmt(nrow(producers))` account for about
`r sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * top10_share)` of all draftee-coach pairs. The
supply differs by position: the quarterback group is the smallest share
of the draft among field positions,
`r sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * qb_share)`, and its `r fmt(qb_coaches)`
coaches produced about `r sprintf("%.1f", qb_per_coach)` draftees each,
against roughly 3 per coach for the volume groups. The undrafted route
shrinks that quarterback share rather than growing it, from
`r sprintf("%.1f%%", qb_share_dr)` of drafted rookies to
`r sprintf("%.1f%%", qb_share_ud)` of undrafted entrants. Most producing
coaches ran a single program, so a coach's draftee count is usually a
program count, with movers like Brian Kelly splitting evenly and Lane
Kiffin piling up at one school. And every count above is one of two
possible countings: half of recent picks name a different coach set when
every college season counts instead of only the last.

## 5. Discussion

::: {.callout-important}
The two counting rules answer different questions and neither is the right
one in the abstract.

- The last-school rule names whoever finished a draftee's college career;
  the every-season rule names everyone who oversaw part of it.
- Nearly half of recent picks name a different coach set depending on which
  question is being asked, so any coach ranking built on draft picks owes
  the reader its counting rule.
:::

::: {.callout-important}
A head coach is associated with a draftee, not solely responsible for him.

- CFBD records head coaches only: no assistant coaches, no coordinators, no
  strength staff.
- The true apprenticeship picture, the Saban tree of coordinators who became
  head coaches, cannot be built from this source, and doing it would mean
  finding one that does.
:::

Several caveats bound these numbers.

- The coach landscape uses classes of 2014 and later, so coaches whose
  draftees came mostly earlier are invisible here.
- The transfer flag is broad, spanning any multi-team pre-draft career
  rather than portal-era transfers specifically.
- The undrafted route counts NFL rookie-roster appearances, so drafted
  players who never reached an NFL roster are absent from both sides of
  that comparison, and undrafted players are identified by the absence of
  a draft pick, which also sweeps in a handful of non-draft entry paths.
- Draftees are a selected group: they come disproportionately from programs
  that recruit well, so coach-level counts conflate the coach with the
  program until a recruiting control or a same-coach-different-school
  comparison is added. Those extensions are queued as followups.
